problems.condition: Portfolio. My house! С. 81. Напиши о своём доме.
steps: Пример: This is our house. This is the kitchen: there's a cupboard, a cooker, a fridge and a table. And this is my bedroom. Look! There's a blue bed and a brown chair. There's a yellow lamp on the table. My toys are under the bed. Our house is very nice!
problems.answer: This is our house. In the kitchen there's a cupboard, a cooker, a fridge and a table. In my bedroom there's a blue bed, a brown chair and a yellow lamp. Our house is very nice!

problems.condition: Portfolio. In the park! С. 83. Напиши, чем заняты люди в парке.
steps: Пример: There are a lot of people in the park today! Look! Children are playing on the playground. A man is walking his dog. A woman is riding a bike. Boys are playing football. Girls are flying their kites. Everybody is having a great time!
problems.answer: There are a lot of people in the park. Children are playing, a man is walking his dog, a woman is riding a bike, boys are playing football, girls are flying kites. Everybody is having a great time!

problems.condition: Portfolio. On Sundays. С. 85. Напиши, что ты делаешь по воскресеньям.
steps: Пример: My favourite day is Sunday. I get up at eight o'clock. In the morning I have a shower, then at nine o'clock I have breakfast. In the afternoon I visit my friend, then I go home and have lunch. In the evening I have supper and listen to music with my sister. At half past nine I go to bed. Sundays are happy days for me!
problems.answer: On Sundays I get up at eight, have a shower and breakfast. In the afternoon I visit my friend and have lunch. In the evening I have supper and listen to music. At half past nine I go to bed.
